items.text: FOR AGENCIES & LEAD-GEN TEAMS RUNNING 5+ CLIENT ACCOUNTS

Stop rebuilding a Clay + HeyReach + ChatGPT + PhantomBuster stack for every client. Valley brings warm signals, qualification, prospect research, your client’s voice, and outreach into one workflow per client—so your team can spend more time on the conversations you’re paid to create.
BOLT BOOKED 25 ENTERPRISE DEMOS IN 45 DAYS
LINARCA BOOKED 15 DEMOS IN THE FIRST MONTH
BOLT BOOKED 25 ENTERPRISE DEMOS IN 45 DAYS

300+ B2B SaaS teams trust Valley’s LinkedIn outbound
— more pipeline from the reps they already have.

The retainer is yours.
The overhead shouldn’t eat it.

Every new account can mean another round of API keys, enrichment tables, prompt writing, and sequence setup. Multiply the maintenance by your client count, and the work starts competing with the service you actually sell.
Win a client. Then onboard them again.

API keys, Clay tables, sequence rebuilds, and tool connections add work before the first message goes out. Repeating that setup across five or ten accounts consumes the hours you could put into strategy and delivery.
Valley brings the steps together. Set the client’s audience, offer, and voice inside the same outbound workflow.
Generic outreach is easy to send and hard to defend in a client review. When replies dry up, the agency has to explain what changed—and why the retainer is still worth paying.
Valley connects buying signals and prospect research to the message. Review what earns a reply and use that context to improve the next campaign.
A client trusts your agency with their LinkedIn account and inbox. Sending more isn’t a strategy; the timing, audience, follow-ups, and replies all need a deliberate process.
Review messages, choose sequence timing, and work within sending limits. A reply stops the sequence so your team can take over the conversation.

Add the next client.
Not another stack to maintain.
Keep the work that makes your agency valuable: the offer, the strategy, and the client relationship. Let Valley connect the research, writing, and follow-up behind it.
A reason to reach out. For every client.

Build each client’s audience from relevant buying signals, a play, or their own list. Valley qualifies prospects and researches the people worth reaching, so your team can spend less time assembling lists and more time refining the client’s offer.

Give Valley the client’s offer, ideal customer, and writing style. Combine that voice with prospect-specific research, then review the messages before they go out. Each account gets its own context—not the same template with a different company name.

Run LinkedIn and email sequences, manage replies, and review campaign results together. When a prospect replies, the sequence stops. Keep the research beside the conversation so your team can hand the client a useful next step, not another spreadsheet.

The proof is in
your clients’ pipeline.

Growth Protocol: 

Valley remove the anxiety around weekly pipeline and sales review meetings. I just say “Look what I booked using Valley”

I care a lot about costs as an agency owner - Valley is far more effective than any other tool we could use for our clients.

Dude, even if the org won’t pay for this, I would invest with this out of my own money and just build pipeline. Then u can justify your raise going into 2026.
"If you're an expert at GTM, Valley is the go-to tool. It's a no-brainer. Train it, upload your leads, and forget — half of the heavy lifting is done by Valley."
